t: University of Utah Health Plans - Individual Health Insurance Company Guide
s: We estimate it serves 8% of all Utahns who buy their own coverage. That's roughly 30,000 Utahns. UofU offers many different types of plans. Some plans include low deductibles and copays. Other plans are high-deductible. These include “HSA-qualified” plans. HSA stands for health savings accounts. HSA-qualified plans allow policyholders to contribute to HSAs tax-free. UofU offers two networks: Healthy Premier and UHealth Plus.
